author: OhLookItsDaOne
description: Automatically posts a configured troubleshooting message when a new thread is created in a designated forum channel.
install_msg: Cog installed. Configure it with `[p]setthreadid` and `[p]setmessage`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild configuration (forum channel ID and troubleshooting message). No end user data is stored.
